content:
Select the ones you want to delete, then press the <Delete> key to send them to the Trash folder, or press <Shift+Delete> to delete them immediately, bypassing Trash.

You can use any of Thunderbird's search features to refine your selection.

If you have your father's password, you can just add his email account to your Thunderbird.

If not, but you can still access your father's Thunderbird, you can copy his emails to a shared local folder and open the local folder from your Thunderbird.

content:
- go to TB menu > Settings > General > Language & Fonts > Fonts > click 'Advanced' button

- at the top, set 'Fonts for:' to Latin if it isn't already

- change Proportional and Monospace fonts/sizes to your liking

- set Minimum font size to 14, or lower if you want a small font size

- at the top, change set 'Fonts for:' to Other Writing Systems

- repeat the process of changing fonts/sizes

- at the bottom, make sure 'Allow messages to use other fonts' is disabled if desired > OK > close the popup
